subject.title: When calling a VLLM model, the usage page statistics show no data. How can I calculate usage and cost when using VLLM?

question: Should self-hosted vLLM with missing or zero model pricing be handled only as documented operator configuration, or should OpenClaw add a product-visible unknown-cost warning or fallback tied to the usage dashboard?
rationale: The code already has vLLM token collection and missing-cost aggregate handling, so the remaining decision is the user-facing pricing contract for local providers rather than a narrow source-proven bug fix.

options.title: Route pricing contract through canonical cost issue
options.body: Keep this report open for missing evidence, but use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90674 as the canonical place to decide warnings or fallback behavior for unknown model pricing.

options.title: Document vLLM cost configuration only
options.body: Treat self-hosted vLLM cost as operator-owned configuration and improve docs/support once the reporter confirms tokens are recorded but cost is missing.

options.title: Add dashboard warning or fallback
options.body: Define and implement a visible Usage-page warning or fallback estimate when vLLM usage tokens are present but pricing is unknown.

recommendation.title: Route pricing contract through canonical cost issue
recommendation.body: Keep this report open for missing evidence, but use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90674 as the canonical place to decide warnings or fallback behavior for unknown model pricing.

likelyOwner.reason: The likely product/code decision centers on usage-cost accounting, where steipete has the strongest recent implementation history.
